versions.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

- Removed the sample file skill-card.md from the project.
- No feature or functionality changes were introduced in this version.

- Added MailerLite brand logo to documentation.
- Minor content and formatting updates in SKILL.md for improved clarity.
- Removed redundant skill-card.md file.
Full rewrite to new standard: added tool reference tables, 3-step GIF table, architecture diagram, code examples, error handling, and troubleshooting.

Initial release:

- Adds MailerLite email marketing management via chat, using ClawLink for easy integration.
- Supports managing subscribers, groups, campaigns, and workflows.
- Guides users through plugin installation, pairing, and connecting their MailerLite account without manual API setup.
- Includes clear instructions for discovering and using available tools safely.
- Enforces confirmation before destructive or bulk actions, and never requests raw credentials.
